mapper.select: select app_type from wf_category where code = #{code} and del_flag = '0' and tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select a.app_type id, c.dict_label name from wf_category a LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data c on a.app_type = c.dict_value LEFT JOIN sys_dict_type b on b.dict_type = c.dict_type where a.`code` = #{code} and del_flag = '0' and a.`tenant_id` = #{tenantId}
